description: This file is a React component for the homepage of a notes application. It fetches and displays a list of notes, providing options to view, edit, or delete each note. It also handles loading and error states.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API and updates state; handles loading and error states.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID after user confirmation; updates the notes list.
